requirements.quote: It connects the Client to the Server.
requirements.condition: When an MQTT Network Connection is established
requirements.required_behavior: The Network Connection must connect an MQTT Client to an MQTT Server.
requirements.why_checkable: A connection's two MQTT endpoint roles can be observed and asserted.

requirements.quote: It provides the means to send an ordered, lossless, stream of bytes in both directions.
requirements.condition: When bytes are carried over the transport underlying an MQTT Network Connection
requirements.required_behavior: The transport must preserve byte order.
requirements.why_checkable: A test transport can compare sent and received byte ordering.

requirements.quote: It provides the means to send an ordered, lossless, stream of bytes in both directions.
requirements.condition: When bytes are carried over the transport underlying an MQTT Network Connection
requirements.required_behavior: The transport must provide lossless delivery of the byte stream.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can compare the complete transmitted and received byte streams for loss.

requirements.quote: It provides the means to send an ordered, lossless, stream of bytes in both directions.
requirements.condition: When an MQTT Network Connection is in use
requirements.required_behavior: The connection must support sending a byte stream in both Client-to-Server and Server-to-Client directions.
requirements.why_checkable: Bidirectional byte transfer can be exercised independently in both directions.

requirements.quote: The data carried by the MQTT protocol across the network for the application. When Application Messages are transported by MQTT they have an associated Quality of Service and a Topic Name.
requirements.condition: When MQTT transports an Application Message
requirements.required_behavior: The Application Message must have an associated Quality of Service.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded or internal representation of every transported Application Message can be checked for a QoS association.

requirements.quote: The data carried by the MQTT protocol across the network for the application. When Application Messages are transported by MQTT they have an associated Quality of Service and a Topic Name.
requirements.condition: When MQTT transports an Application Message
requirements.required_behavior: The Application Message must have an associated Topic Name.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded or internal representation of every transported Application Message can be checked for a Topic Name association.

requirements.quote: A Client always establishes the Network Connection to the Server.
requirements.condition: When a Client and Server begin an MQTT Network Connection
requirements.required_behavior: The Client must be the endpoint that establishes the Network Connection to the Server.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not be treated as the endpoint that initiates an MQTT Network Connection to a Client.
requirements.why_checkable: Connection establishment can be traced to identify which endpoint initiated the underlying connection.

requirements.quote: Accepts Network Connections from Clients.
requirements.condition: For an implementation acting as an MQTT Server
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation must provide the Server capability to accept Network Connections from Clients.
requirements.why_checkable: A client can attempt to establish a valid Network Connection and the Server's acceptance can be observed.

requirements.quote: Accepts Application Messages published by Clients.
requirements.condition: For an implementation acting as an MQTT Server
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation must provide the Server capability to accept Application Messages published by Clients.
requirements.why_checkable: A valid client publication can be sent and Server acceptance can be observed through protocol behavior.

requirements.quote: Processes Subscribe and Unsubscribe requests from Clients.
requirements.condition: For an implementation acting as an MQTT Server
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation must provide the Server capability to process Subscribe requests from Clients.
requirements.why_checkable: A Subscribe request can be issued and its resulting subscription state and response observed.

requirements.quote: Processes Subscribe and Unsubscribe requests from Clients.
requirements.condition: For an implementation acting as an MQTT Server
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation must provide the Server capability to process Unsubscribe requests from Clients.
requirements.why_checkable: An Unsubscribe request can be issued and its resulting subscription state and response observed.

requirements.quote: Forwards Application Messages that match Client Subscriptions.
requirements.condition: When an Application Message matches a Client Subscription
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must forward the matching Application Message to the subscribed Client.
requirements.why_checkable: A subscription and matching publication can be created and delivery to the subscribed Client observed.

requirements.quote: A Subscription comprises a Topic Filter and a maximum QoS.
requirements.condition: For every Subscription
requirements.required_behavior: The Subscription must contain a Topic Filter.
requirements.why_checkable: Subscription state can be inspected for the required Topic Filter component.

requirements.quote: A Subscription comprises a Topic Filter and a maximum QoS.
requirements.condition: For every Subscription
requirements.required_behavior: The Subscription must contain a maximum QoS value.
requirements.why_checkable: Subscription state can be inspected for the required maximum-QoS component.

requirements.quote: A Subscription is associated with a single Session.
requirements.condition: For every Subscription
requirements.required_behavior: The Subscription must be associated with exactly one Session.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: A Subscription must not be associated with zero Sessions or with multiple Sessions.
requirements.why_checkable: The Subscription-to-Session relationship can be inspected and its cardinality asserted as one.

requirements.quote: A Session can contain more than one Subscription.
requirements.condition: When a Client creates multiple valid Subscriptions in one Session
requirements.required_behavior: The Session must be capable of containing more than one Subscription.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can create two valid Subscriptions in one Session and inspect whether both coexist.

requirements.quote: Each Subscription within a session has a different Topic Filter.
requirements.condition: When a Session contains multiple Subscriptions
requirements.required_behavior: Each Subscription in that Session must have a Topic Filter distinct from every other Subscription in the same Session.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Session must not contain two separate Subscriptions with the same Topic Filter.
requirements.why_checkable: All Topic Filters stored for one Session can be compared for uniqueness.

requirements.quote:
Topic Name:
The label attached to an Application Message which is matched against the Subscriptions known to the Server.
requirements.condition: When the Server determines which Subscriptions match an Application Message
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must match the Application Message's Topic Name against its known Subscriptions.
requirements.why_checkable: Known Subscriptions and a publication Topic Name can be controlled and the Server's match result observed.

requirements.quote: The Server sends a copy of the Application Message to each Client that has a matching Subscription.
requirements.condition: When one or more Clients have a Subscription matching an Application Message
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must send a copy of the Application Message to every Client that has a matching Subscription.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not omit a Client that has a matching Subscription.
requirements.why_checkable: A set of matching and non-matching subscribers can be created and deliveries observed per Client.

requirements.quote: A Topic Filter can include wildcard characters.
requirements.condition: When a Subscription uses a Topic Filter containing wildcard characters
requirements.required_behavior: The Topic Filter syntax must permit wildcard characters; their presence does not by itself make an expression structurally not a Topic Filter.
requirements.why_checkable: A wildcard-containing Topic Filter can be submitted and exercised against matching Topic Names.

requirements.quote: A stateful interaction between a Client and a Server. Some Sessions last only as long as the Network Connection, others can span multiple consecutive Network Connections between a Client and a Server.
requirements.condition: For a Session whose lifetime is intended to span Network Connections
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation would preserve that Session across multiple consecutive Network Connections between the same Client and Server.
requirements.why_checkable: The text establishes two possible Session lifetime classes but does not state the protocol condition that selects either class, so a complete conformance test cannot be derived from this evidence alone.

requirements.quote: A packet of information that is sent across the Network Connection.
requirements.condition: When an MQTT Control Packet is transmitted
requirements.required_behavior: The Control Packet must be sent across the MQTT Network Connection.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet transmission can be traced and associated with the active MQTT Network Connection.

requirements.quote: The MQTT specification defines fourteen different types of Control Packet, one of which (the PUBLISH packet) is used to convey Application Messages.
requirements.condition: For the MQTT Control Packet type space
requirements.required_behavior: The type space must comprise the fourteen distinct Control Packet types defined by the specification.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation's packet-type discriminator can be tested across the fixed set of fourteen protocol-defined types.

requirements.quote: The MQTT specification defines fourteen different types of Control Packet, one of which (the PUBLISH packet) is used to convey Application Messages.
requirements.condition: When an Application Message is conveyed in an MQTT Control Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The Application Message must be conveyed using a PUBLISH Control Packet.
requirements.why_checkable: The Control Packet type carrying an Application Message can be decoded and asserted as PUBLISH.
